title: The "pookie" cop blushes
situation: A creator films a light-hearted exchange with a constable to an unreleased Lana Del Rey "good girl" audio; he goes viral as the "pookie cop". Shown his own reel, he blushes. Protesters recreate similar clips with police across sites.

lines.text: Protesters call officers "pookie" while lip-syncing to the audio.
lines.speaker: trend description

reactionBeats: Shy smile and blush when he sees himself.
music: Unreleased Lana Del Rey "good girl" audio.

paraphrased: Users called him "pookie" and praised his calm, humble response.

buildThis.situation: Pester "cute": tell Sharma he is "pookie" on camera; he tries to stay stern, fails, and an hour later shows the player his own reel on his phone.
